name: PT Modernland Realty Tbk
summary: PT Modernland Realty Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, develops and sells real estate properties in Indonesia. The company engages in the township, residential, and industrial town development business; and sale of real estate and apartments, as well as property leasing services. It also operates and manages golf courses, club house restaurants, and hotels, as well as offers hospitality and commercial services. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia.
